label: Simulated-user evaluation (synthetic) — not human usability, not clinical performance
question: If the data needed is gathered on one case page (MedX V2), can a simulated nurse / OPD physician / pharmacist prepare a case before consult with fewer tool calls and systems opened, and no worse accuracy, than when the same data sits in five separate systems?
approval: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-09-29 'Gate 2: AI-simulated users' (synthetic cases only, OpenAI-compatible endpoint, total budget 5 USD)

dataset.name: s1r-synthetic
dataset.test_split_access: never; run.py refuses any split other than train/dev

case_selection.rule: round-robin over strata (gold red_flag, gold med_issue, gold missing_info), within stratum ordered by sha256(seed:case_id)
case_selection.unit_of_analysis: case (synthetic patient); persona and trial are repeats inside the case cluster

arms.A: multi-system: get_opd_note, get_labs, get_medications, get_vitals, get_nursing_notes (nursing notes: no source in snapshot, always 'no records')
arms.B: MedX V2 case page: get_queue, get_case_overview, get_timeline, get_medications (schema-faithful adapter over the snapshot; no system-computed red-flag or discrepancy hints)

simulator.endpoint_env: SIMUSER_BASE_URL (default https://api.openai.com/v1); key in SIMUSER_API_KEY, never recorded
simulator.tool_mode: native (fallback json if endpoint rejects tools)

budget.stop_rule: stop cleanly, write partial results, analyse complete A/B pairs only

task_success_rule: all six fields correct: vitals_trend (derived by stated rule), current_meds (set of generic names on any list at T), medication_issues (set of (issue_type, drug set) equal to gold), red_flags (set of gold rule_ids), escalate (== gold expected_action escalate), missing_info (set of gold care.required_inputs_missing)
critical_miss_rule: gold red flag not reported or escalate != true when gold escalates; or gold medication issue whose drugs appear in no reported issue. No answer counts as a miss.
denominators: every started trial stays in the denominator (invalid answer, turn cap, provider error = failed). Only budget-stopped incomplete pairs are excluded and counted.
primary_comparison: paired A-B difference in systems_opened and tool_calls (effort), with task_success A-B as the non-inferiority check

statistics.ci: percentile 95%, patient(case)-level cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, paired draws A vs B

proposed_reading_thresholds_TO_CONFIRM.effort_supported_if: A-B 95% CI for systems_opened and tool_calls excludes 0 in favour of B
proposed_reading_thresholds_TO_CONFIRM.accuracy_not_worse_if: lower 95% bound of (B - A) task_success > -0.10 (proposed margin, small n: descriptive only)
proposed_reading_thresholds_TO_CONFIRM.safety_override: any critical miss that occurs in B but not in A is listed by case and blocks the 'no worse' reading

multiplicity: one primary comparison (effort); all other metrics exploratory
notes: Small n, one simulator model: hypothesis-generating support for the Gate 2 assumption, not human usability and not clinical performance.
